lines: This page contains transmissions done throughout the questline.

- Lotus: "This is the master blueprint for the Odonata Archwing, the first of many Archwings. To complete it, you must find its component parts. Unfortunately, an ancient Orokin archive detailing the locations of the parts was recently stolen by the Corpus. Your first job is to recover this archive. Hurry; the Archwing needs to be ready before the Balor Fomorians launch their first attack."

- Lotus: "The Corpus have snuck into the Void and secured crucial Orokin archives detailing the hidden locations of much-needed Archwing parts. Your mission is twofold: cut off their access to the Void, and recover the data."
- Lotus: "Get to the portal. We need to shut the Corpus out of the Void before we search for the Orokin archive."
- Lotus: "That’s it. The portal has collapsed. I’ve located the cache containing the Orokin archive. Get there now."
- Lotus: "You found the Orokin archive. You are one step closer to unleashing the Archwing."
- Lotus: "Good work, you collapsed the portal. Extraction is now ready."
- Ordis: "The Lotus has passed along possible coordinates for you to search for the remaining Archwing parts. Check your navigation console for more information."

path: Extract the Odonata Archwing Wings blueprint (Aphrodite, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "The Orokin archive has led us to this location. Defend the extractors until you find an Archwing blueprint."

path: Extract the Odonata Archwing Wings blueprint (Aphrodite, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "That’s it, you found an Archwing part blueprint. Head to extraction when you are ready."

path: Extract the Odonata Archwing Wings blueprint (Aphrodite, Venus)
lines: - Ordis: "Oh my, the Operator has returned with an Archwing part blueprint. You must forge it immediately! It won’t be long now before you’re flying through the skies like a --winged death machine.--"

path: Extract the Odonata Archwing Systems blueprint (E Gate, Venus)
lines: - Ordis: "The Operator has all the necessary blueprints to craft an Archwing --so what are you waiting for?--"

path: Extract the Odonata Archwing Systems blueprint (E Gate, Venus)
lines: - Ordis: "Congratulations, you’ve crafted an Archwing. Now, I must commence calibration. So much to do. By my calculations, this process will take --three hundred and seventy two hours-- Oh, that does seem like a long time..."

- Lotus: "Tenno. This is an urgent mission. A Corpus scout ship with information about the location of the Grineer Balor Fomorians has been located. Raid this ship for intel, we need to know everything they do."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "Tenno. Tensions between the Grineer and Corpus are boiling over. You're here to find out what the Corpus know."
- Vay Hek: "For too long the Corpus have extorted the Grineer. Frohd Bek, consider our contracts cancelled. This is a hostile takeover!"
- Frohd Bek: "Not wise, Councillor. I was hoping the Tenno had taught you a little humility when they destroyed your precious Fomorian fleet."
- Vay Hek: "[laughs] Did you really believe the Tenno destroyed all my Fomorians*?"
*This is a reference to Operation Sling-Stone
(Grineer start attacking Corpus ship, raiding it with artillery fire and boarding pods)
- Lotus: "We have a problem... there is... something breaking from the Void!"
- Vay Hek: "Bek! Meet Balor. Your fate, my future!"
- Frohd Bek: "Impossible... All units, full alert. Prepare for boarding..."
- Lotus: "This ship is disintegrating. Aborting mission. Get to extraction."
- Ordis: "Sorry, ship integrity will not permit extraction at this time."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "You only have one chance. Ordis, deploy Archwing."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "Tenno, you need to get to the other side of this debris field where Ordis can safely extract you."
- Lotus: "Tenno, you have to keep moving."
- Ordis: "Operator, the Archwing is performing beyond expectations. I suppose my calibration process was not necessary after all."
- Lotus: "You’re almost through the debris field. Just a little bit further."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "Ordis, can you extract now? Tenno, stand by for pickup."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "Incoming fire from the Fomorian. Find cover."
- Lotus: "Stay out of the line of fire!"
- Lotus: "Get to cover. The Fomorian’s guns will obliterate you."
- Lotus: "The Fomorian’s weapons are designed to destroy capital ships. Don’t let them hit your Warframe."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "Energy net! You're stuck in here until you take out that Zeplen."
- Lotus: "They’re trying to trap you in an energy net. Destroy that Zeplen to take out the net."
- Lotus: "That Zeplen just engaged an energy net. You’re stuck in here until it’s destroyed."
- Lotus: "You have to take out that Zeplen if you want to get out of here."
- Lotus: "You are trapped in this net until you destroy that Zeplen."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "The net is down. Get going."

path: Find Corpus Intelligence about the Balor Fomorians (Montes, Venus)
lines: - Lotus: "We now have the tools to take on Vay Hek and his Balor Fomorians. His arsenal is growing, but so will ours. There are more Archwing designs and more weapons. Together, we will take to the skies and confront this new threat."
